acceptance.given: An actor attempts to publish an acceptance-passed result and the current Acceptance lifecycle owner is explicitly identified.

oracle.expected: Publication succeeds only for the current Acceptance lifecycle owner; every non-owner attempt is denied.
oracle.observable: The Acceptance lifecycle publication entry records an owner-bound allow or a non-owner denial without treating derived authorization metadata as publication authority.

acceptance.then: The Acceptance owner entry is the only publication authority; derived artifacts remain non-authorizing.
acceptance.when: At acceptance publication authorization evaluation, before the acceptance-passed artifact is committed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a non-empty authorization set or owner identity mismatch and assert publication is denied.
Invoke the real Acceptance publication entry with a non-owner actor and assert no acceptance-passed publication occurs.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind acceptance-passed publication authorization to the real Acceptance lifecycle owner entry; derived evidence cannot publish the lifecycle state.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the Acceptance lifecycle interface and reject non-owner publication without changing derived evidence schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: publication attempt -> current Acceptance owner check -> owner-only acceptance-passed or deterministic denial
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The real Acceptance publication entry permits only the current lifecycle owner and denies every non-owner attempt.

acceptance.given: Named Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts are enumerated and their authorization metadata is parsed as structured machine-readable data.

oracle.expected: Every specified artifact has authorizes=[]; non-empty, missing, unreadable, or malformed metadata is rejected.
forbidden: Any specified artifact has a non-empty authorization set.
An omitted or malformed artifact is reported compliant.
oracle.observable: The conformance preflight report lists every artifact and exits non-success for any value other than an explicit empty array.

acceptance.then: Only explicit authorizes=[] satisfies the derived-evidence condition.
acceptance.when: During artifact authorization verification before acceptance publication authorization.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run conformance preflight against an artifact containing one authorization entry and assert rejection.
Run conformance preflight with an omitted, unreadable, or malformed artifact and assert fail-closed behavior.

affected_subjects: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev derived artifacts
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce explicit authorizes=[] for every enumerated derived artifact and reject all other, missing, or malformed values.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing receipt fields and fail-closed behavior while requiring the real authorizes field to equal an empty array.

slice_hint.state_transition: derived authorization metadata unverified -> explicit authorizes=[] verification or deterministic rejection
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Conformance preflight succeeds only when every named artifact is readable, structurally valid, and has authorizes=[] exactly.
